title: Construct dependent geometry from typed relationships
when: A geometric edit should preserve incidence or center/foot relationships.
do: Maintain stable point/segment/ray IDs and a construction DAG.
Specify intersection extent and branch; reject zero-length and near-parallel degeneracy.
Evaluate labels and marks after their owners.
check: Incidence and source-required residuals hold; unchanged objects retain identity.
limitation: Existing finite constructors are seeds; the proposed universal DAG/validator is not installed.
